description:
A cloud provider benchmark data file is available at ~/Documents/cloud_benchmark_scores.txt. Your task is to visualize this data using a Radar (Spider) Chart in Wondershare EdrawMax. 

1. Create a new 'Spider and Radar' chart.
2. Enter the data exactly as provided in the text file for three series (AWS, Azure, GCP) and five metrics (Cost Efficiency, Global Availability, Compute Performance, Support Quality, Ease of Use).
3. Set the chart title to 'Cloud Provider Evaluation 2026'.
4. Ensure the legend is visible.
5. Save the editable diagram as 'cloud_radar_comparison.eddx' in /home/ga/Documents/.
6. Export the chart as a PNG image named 'cloud_radar_comparison.png' in /home/ga/Documents/.
